name: PowerToys
description: Verifies installer Authenticode chain, pins signer='Microsoft Corporation', checks revocation, pins MSI UpgradeCode to block confused-deputy (anti-TOCTOU, cites an MSRC case). Well-hardened.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow primary updater classification: PowerToys verifies the exact installer handle with WinVerifyTrust, checks Microsoft signer identity and revocation state, and pins expected product identity before launch.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact signing or deployment state beyond the checked-in configuration.
Where electron-updater/Squirrel/install4j performs final verification, the external framework implementation is not vendored here.
